dataset: Oxford Path Dependent Battery Degradation Dataset Parts 1 and 2

baseline.selection_rule: first BoL RPT listed by the official Part 1 guide for every cell

endpoint.stage: Part 2 RPT18 and end of life EIS
endpoint.selection_rule: RPT18 for every cell, the latest common numbered RPT in the official Part 2 guide

capacity.calculation: discharged ampere-hours within step 8, using the native capacity channel after confirming its reset convention

rint.selection_rule: first documented 50 percent SOC pulse step, fixed before current or voltage inspection
rint.calculation: absolute value of (V at pulse start plus 10 seconds minus V at pulse start) divided by median nonzero pulse current

eis.interpolation: linear interpolation of each impedance component against log10 frequency after sorting and rejecting nonfinite or duplicate frequencies
eis.imaginary_sign: convert publisher Zimag to -Im(Z), confirmed by spectrum orientation and then applied identically to all files

baselines.eis: same-cell BoL 50 percent SOC spectrum carried forward

acceptance.each_head: pooled error at least 5 percent below its frozen baseline
